purpose: Registry of the documented local command surface. `bun run <name>` delegates to scripts/task_acceptance.py, which reads this file. `active` commands must pass now; `declared` commands fail explicitly until their `requires` prerequisites and implementation exist, then run without further edits. Test commands must collect at least one test; zero collected tests is a failure, never a pass. Edits to this file are a root-manifest-owner change (T01 bootstrap, then T02).

collection_modes.harness-unittest: The harness counts unittest discovery itself before and after the run; zero collected or zero ran is a failure.
collection_modes.runner-exit: The named runner exits nonzero on empty collections (playwright reports 'no tests found', pytest exits 5, node --test fails unmatched globs). The harness still treats exit 0 with zero matched tests as impossible for these runners.

verify.description: Every registered check that exists today. Later tasks extend members when their suites are implemented.

self-check.description: Registry consistency: scripts exist, groups resolve, declared commands fail honestly.

test:native-bootstrap.description: Native project boundary checks; stdlib only until T02 resolves dependencies.

check:coordination.description: Coordination admission/override tests; refuses empty collections itself.

build.description: Static and shared Node build only; no deployment.

build:packages.description: Shared packages compile in declared project-reference order.

test:browser.description: Playwright own-file/fixture/cancel/export flows; suite paths are passed after `--`.

test:privacy.description: Cold/warm/offline canary network and storage capture on the built site.

test:a11y.description: Automated accessible component checks; manual AT receipts remain separately required.

test:visual.description: Approved desktop/narrow/reduced-motion/error-state screenshots; baselines never auto-update.

test:fixtures.description: Regenerate controlled fixtures and assert byte/source manifest expectations. Implementation is registered by the fixture owner; no runner is assumed.

test:regression.description: Baseline immutability, coverage loss, invalid comparison and rule exit behavior.

test:native.description: Native adapter/CLI/process/resource/import tests. Frozen run: never silently resolves a lockfile.

check:static-dist.description: No dynamic server artifact or paid bindings; hashes/sizes/notices/external allowlist.
